summary: In Taholah, Quinault Indian Nation, Washington, Quinault Taholah Village Relocation is an implementation initiative. The documented approach is to plan phased relocation of Taholah Village to higher ground to address coastal and river-flooding risks. The case addresses coastal/river flooding and storm-surge exposure. Available materials report master-plan adoption and phased relocation planning. The available materials do not identify a measured relocation outcome.
title: Quinault Taholah Village Relocation
